jsonld_raw.name: NEPTUNE MAGAZINE 2
jsonld_raw.description:
This edition explores the concept of true icons, inspired by the Oxford Dictionary definition: people or things admired that represent an idea or a way of life. On this occasion, the spotlight is on Lauren Hutton, one of the most influential models in history, whose authenticity, free spirit, and unique vision have redefined the fashion industry for nearly six decades.

Through a journey across her extraordinary career, the publication revisits her close collaboration with photographer Richard Avedon, the signing of the first million-dollar contract for a model, and her passion for traveling the world, driven by the desire to discover new cultures beyond the runway. Her memories of figures like Diana Vreeland and her travels through Morocco, Persia, or Bali reflect a life marked by curiosity, independence, and adventure.

Furthermore, this edition brings together a curated selection of interviews, features, and collaborations with prominent names in art, fashion, design, and architecture—including Boucheron, Dries Van Noten, Joseph Dirand, François Halard, The Row, Saint Laurent, Hauser & Wirth, Jacques Garcia, and Urban Jürgensen—offering a sophisticated look at the contemporary creative universe.
